concept: a knight who hunts trolls in the high passes and wears their teeth as trophies
a swarm of arrows loosed by the ghost of an archer who died on the wall
a sailor who rides the storm-surge into harbour on a stolen longboat
a golem-forged greatsword that fights on its own, dragging its wielder behind it
a human weaver who spins spider-silk into nets and throws them over thieves
a priest who has never held a weapon and curses the congregation from the pulpit
